summary: Hotel101 Global Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing that certain subsidiaries agreed to sell 780 Hotel101 units to DD Hotel101 Worldwide One Pte. Ltd., a third-party consortium, for an expected total contract price of about US$205 million upon completion. An affiliate will sell the consortium 300 more units for about $33 million. Units span Niseko, Madrid, Libis, plus deposits for Melbourne and Milan projects. The Audit Committee and Board approved; controlling shareholder DoubleDragon is a minority consortium investor. Revenue is recognized on a percentage-of-completion basis.
